about.aboutMain: I am Chandre Leigh Davids, a Full Stack Developer with a real passion for creating meaningful digital experiences. I enjoy working on both the backend and frontend, always looking for ways to improve and learn something new along the way. There's always something fresh to explore in development, and that constant opportunity to learn is what keeps me excited about this field. I’m always up for a challenge, and I love collaborating with others to bring ideas to life!
about.aboutBrief: I was born and raised in Rocklands Mitchell's. I`m able to speak and communicate in English and Afrikaans and I am hardworking as well as always up for a challenge.
